- Initial release of Video Compressor Parkside.
- Easily compress large video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV up to 500MB) to smaller, high-quality 1080p MP4 for fast download and sharing.
- Simple setup with automatic cloud connection and token generation (100 free credits).
- Supports natural language instructions for compression—no manual slider adjustment needed.
- Handles common video workflows: quick edit, batch processing, and iterative refinement.
- Provides clear feedback and error messages during the upload, compression, and export process.
